newsitem.title: FRANCE: Lagardere says still wants Thomson.
newsitem.headline: Lagardere says still wants Thomson.

text.p: Lagardere Groupe on Wednesday reaffirmed its interest in buying state electronics firm Thomson SA after the government said it was suspending the sell-off on the advice of the privatisation commission.
The government had preferred Lagardere's bid for Thomson over an offer by Alcatel but the commission said it could not approve part of Lagardere's offer.
"The acquisition of Thomson remains a strategic issue for us," Lagardere said in a statement.

"We reaffirm our willingness to pursue our efforts to reach the goal we have set ourselves and we await with interest and confidence the new rules chosen by the government and we take into account the privatisation commission's opinion," it said.

The government said earlier it was suspending the Thomson sell-off to Lagardere due to reservations by the privatisation commission over the planned sale of the company's consumer electronics unit to South Korea's Daewoo Electronics.
The finance ministry said it would quickly issue new guidelines on a privatisation it regards as indispensible.
